verdict.rationale: Wise documents a multi-currency account that lets users hold, convert, and fund transfers from balances in up to 56 currencies. Supporting docs cover global account details for getting paid in 40+ currencies and balance statements in multiple formats, which together deliver multi-currency balance management from one account. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of day-to-day multi-currency balance management, and first-party detail on the founder-facing (non-API) balance management experience.
